gloss: blushing; turning red in the face

definitions.gloss: blushing; turning red with embarrassment or shame
definitions.explanation: The face turning red due to embarrassment, shame, or awkwardness. Can describe both the physical reaction and the feeling of embarrassment itself.

examples.japanese: {褒|ほ}められて{赤面|せきめん}した。
examples.english: I blushed when I was praised.

examples.japanese: {失言|しつげん}に{気|き}づいて{赤面|せきめん}した。
examples.english: I turned red when I realized my slip of the tongue.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{赤面|せきめん}しながら、{好|す}きだと{告白|こくはく}した。
examples.english: He confessed his feelings while blushing.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}すと、{今|いま}でも{赤面|せきめん}してしまう。
examples.english: Whenever I recall past mistakes, I still blush.

notes:
Describes the physical act of blushing due to embarrassment or shame. The word combines {赤|せき} (red) and {面|めん} (face). More literary and formal than the everyday expression {顔|かお}が{赤|あか}くなる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤面|せきめん}する: to blush
- {赤面|せきめん}もの: something embarrassing (enough to make one blush)
- {思|おも}わず{赤面|せきめん}する: to blush involuntarily

REGISTER:
More literary and formal than colloquial expressions. In everyday speech, {顔|かお}が{赤|あか}くなる or {恥|は}ずかしくて{赤|あか}くなる are more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {顔|かお}が{赤|あか}くなる: to turn red in the face — everyday expression
- {照|て}れる: to feel embarrassed, to be shy — focuses on the emotion rather than the physical reaction
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}: turning pale — the opposite physical reaction, caused by shock or fear
